title: Nether Ores
description: This mod makes it so that Overworld ores spawn in the Nether, too!
body:
# Nether Ores
## What is Nether Ores?
Pretty self-explanatory, Nether Ores adds the Overworld ores in the Nether, making the Nether more fun to explore and mine in.
## Issues
None so far!
## Terms of Use
You are welcome to edit the mod as you wish, so long as you **do not** republish or share, the edited version **must** stay in your possession.
